name: BTC Yield Reversal Strategy
description: Long/short BTC/USD strategy that goes long when US 10-year Treasury yields have fallen for 3 consecutive days and short when yields have risen for 3 consecutive days. Always in market with position reversals on opposite signals.
source:
# BTC Yield Reversal Strategy
# Long BTC when 10Y yields fall for 3 consecutive days
# Short BTC when 10Y yields rise for 3 consecutive days

# Market data source for BTC at 1H timeframe
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1H)()
close = src.c

# Load US 10-Year Treasury yield data
# Data is indexed by announcement date to avoid forward-looking bias
yield_obs_date, yield_10y, yield_revision = common_economic_indicators(category=MacroEconomicsIndicator.Treasury10Y)()

# Forward-fill daily yield data to align with 1H BTC bars
yield_filled = ffill(yield_10y)

# Detect consecutive falling yields (3 days = long signal)
yields_falling = falling(length=3)(yield_filled)

# Detect consecutive rising yields (3 days = short signal)
yields_rising = rising(length=3)(yield_filled)

# Position management - always in market with reversals
# Long when yields falling, short when yields rising
signal = long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=yields_falling, short_entry=yields_rising)

# Fixed notional sizing - 100% exposure
# Signal is 1 for long, -1 for short, 0 for flat
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=signal.signal * 100)

# Visualization - Yield data
timeseries_lines(
    title="US 10-Year Treasury Yield",
    category="Indicators",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="10Y Yield", color=Color.Blue)
    ])
)(yield_filled)

# Visualization - Signal indicators
timeseries_lines(
    title="Yield Direction Signals",
    category="Indicators",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Yields Falling (Long)", color=Color.Green),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Yields Rising (Short)", color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(yields_falling, yields_rising)

# Visualization - Position signal
timeseries_lines(
    title="Position Signal",
    category="Signals",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Signal (1=Long, -1=Short)", color=Color.Purple)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title="Neutral", color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ])
)(signal.signal)
